description: Canonical registry of Arrow transport channel bindings. Schema and validation semantics defined by Arrow Transport Model v1.0.
v1_5_0_draft_changes: Version bump for registry consistency with Arrow Registries v1.5-draft.
v0_2_http_rest_hardening_changes: Adds explicit local HTTP and HTTPS REST deployment bindings. The legacy http-rest entry is retained inactive as a compatibility marker only.

schema_notes.local_only: True when the binding is restricted to localhost development and tests.
schema_notes.requires_tls: True when deployments must provide TLS in transit; v0.2 uses upstream TLS termination.

entries.name: HTTP REST v1.0 (legacy)
entries.description: Legacy HTTP REST pilot binding retained as an inactive compatibility marker. Use http-rest-local for localhost development or https-rest for TLS-terminated deployments.

entries.name: HTTP REST Local v0.2
entries.description: Localhost-only HTTP REST binding for development and tests. Plain HTTP is not a production-facing deployment profile.

entries.name: HTTPS REST v0.2
entries.description: Production-facing HTTP REST deployment profile where TLS is terminated by a trusted upstream reverse proxy or managed ingress before forwarding to arrow-node on loopback or a private interface.
